questions.question: Which mobile platform and compatibility target should the app use?
questions.recommendedChoice: Native Android (Kotlin) app; HarmonyOS compatibility mode supporting Android APK; not HarmonyOS NEXT native

options.label: Native Android (Kotlin) app; HarmonyOS compatibility mode supporting Android APK; not HarmonyOS NEXT native
options.description: Build a native Android application and support compatible HarmonyOS devices by running the Android APK; do not target HarmonyOS NEXT native.

questions.answer: Native Android (Kotlin) app; HarmonyOS compatibility mode supporting Android APK; not HarmonyOS NEXT native
questions.rationale: This preserves the requested Android-native implementation and HarmonyOS Android-APK compatibility target, without a desktop or HarmonyOS NEXT native target.

questions.question: What fitness-tracking features and offline behavior are essential?
questions.recommendedChoice: Offline local storage; daily workout logging with exercise, sets, weight, and reps; workout templates; workout history/calendar and progress statistics; body weight and measurements; rest timer; import, export, and backup.
questions.answer: Offline-first, local-only storage on the device. Support daily workout logging with exercise, sets, weight, and reps; workout templates; workout history with calendar and progress statistics; body weight and body measurements; a rest timer; and import, export, and backup.
questions.rationale: These are the user-provided product requirements. Records remain available offline on-device; import/export/backup is user-controlled and does not imply cloud persistence or an API.

questions.question: Which data stores should the app use?

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Use offline local storage on the device; do not provision a cloud data store.

questions.rationale: The app is offline and local-first, with device-local storage only and no cloud persistence.

questions.question: Should users sign in to use the app's API features?

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users sign in to use application API features.

options.label: No
options.description: No sign-in; use the local app without an API.

questions.rationale: There is no backend/API and no sign-in; the app stores records locally on the device.
